name: Riograndense Republic
alt: Republic of Rio Grande do Sul

predecessors.name: Empire of Brazil
predecessors.text: the Province of São Pedro do Rio Grande do Sul, partly split off

successors.name: Empire of Brazil
successors.text: the republic 'reincorporated into the Brazilian Empire' as the province of Rio Grande do Sul

ledger.x: 1836: the republic and the empire dispute the province.
1839: the Riograndense navy takes Laguna in Santa Catarina.

1845: peace. 'Finally, on 1 March 1845, peace was signed: the Ponche Verde Treaty, after almost ten years of war'; complete amnesty for the rebels, freedom for the slaves who fought in the Republican Army. The Ragamuffin War page has it signed at Dom Pedrito, with the rebels choosing the next provincial president and…

wars.name: Ragamuffin War
wars.outcome: Negotiated end: the Ponche Verde Treaty of 1 March 1845 gave the rebels complete amnesty and reincorporated the republic into the Empire of Brazil; the Juliana Republic had been crushed when Laguna was retaken on 1 November 1839.

certainty.note: The republic's territory was a 'partial split' of the province whose limits with Uruguay were 'fully defined only after the war'; which towns each side held is not on the page.
